summary: @ornikar/rollup-plugin-postcss preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's `preinstall` hook runs `setup.mjs`, an obfuscator.io-obfuscated script (hex identifiers, per-function string-lookup objects, split literals) that pins Bun v1.3.13, downloads the platform-appropriate Bun archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts and chmods the `bun` binary, and then invokes it against a sibling `math_init.js` (~727KB, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header, WV8StW array-shift string decoder plus a large hex/string constant pool with an alphabet-permutation decoder). Both files sit at the tarball root and are outside the declared `files: ["dist"]` manifest. The package presents itself as `@ornikar/rollup-plugin-postcss` while retaining the upstream `rollup-plugin-postcss` author (`EGOIST <0x142857@gmail.com>`), repository URL, and README; the legitimate upstream ships neither a preinstall script nor these payload files. The alternate-runtime-dropper pattern — executing bundled opaque code via a freshly downloaded second language runtime rather than Node — runs arbitrary attacker-controlled code on any installer at `npm install` time and evades Node-only inspection of the executed payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
